first_experiment.title: Re-draft last month's real commentary with Copilot, after close

hypothesis.statement: On last month's real variance page and real cause notes, Copilot-assisted drafting plus a cause-and-sign check takes at least 30% less time than the original drafting did.
hypothesis.would_be_wrong_if: The assisted route, including checks, is not clearly faster than your usual drafting, or needs 3+ substantive corrections.

relevance.why_for_this_user: Moves the test onto your real pack now IT has approved it; uses last month's section, so close week stays untouched.

steps.instruction: After close, open last month's variance page and your cause notes. Note roughly how long the original commentary took (or time a similar page).
In Copilot (company account only), draft the commentary from the page and notes; edit to your standard. Time it.
Do a deliberate check: every cause against your notes, every favourable/unfavourable sign. Count corrections.
Fill the note template. Don't send anything; this is a rehearsal.

materials.description: Last month's real variance page and cause notes, used only inside the company Copilot tenant.

prediction.user: About 15 minutes saved; the check will catch one or two things.
prediction.engine: Expect a saving similar to the synthetic test, with more correction effort on messy cause notes.

measures.what: Minutes the original commentary took (or a timed similar page)
Minutes to sendable commentary with Copilot, including edits
Substantive corrections (wrong cause, wrong number, wrong sign, misleading framing)
Would you send the assisted version after ≤10 minutes of edits?
Where the assisted draft went wrong

learning_criteria.confirms_if: M2 ≤ 0.7 × M1 and M4 = yes and M3 ≤ 2
learning_criteria.informative_note: Either way we learn whether drafting or checking is the real work in the pack.
